response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with 20+ years of diverse technical background and recent engagement with AI infrastructure work over the past 16 months. However, the Principal Engineer role specifically requires deep, demonstrated expertise in AI/ML strategy and products, along with director-level seniority. While his recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks is promising, there's insufficient evidence of the specialized AI expertise, AI product development experience, and strategic advisory capabilities this role demands.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience spanning diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded) well exceeding the 15-year requirement
Currently engaged in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development for 16+ months, demonstrating active involvement with modern AI technologies
Strong cloud infrastructure expertise (AWS CDK, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD) directly applicable to cloud platform strategy
concerns: No demonstrated deep AI/ML expertise, machine learning knowledge, or experience building AI-powered products or platforms
Title progression shows 'Staff Engineer' and 'Senior Developer' levels; does not match the director-level individual contributor seniority required
Career trajectory shows implementation and technical execution focus; limited evidence of strategic thinking, customer advisory, or technical vision leadership for emerging technologies

key_factors.factor: Limited AI/ML expertise and AI product strategy experience
Strong cloud infrastructure and architecture knowledge
